name: Rexburg Rumble 2025
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the Registration and Waistlist Info tab. Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDV2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--760640937e3cdd34b437c98211ca800d567615d4/image.png)
